Container.Name: jellyfin-merge-proxy
Container.Overview: Merges several Jellyfin servers into one. TV and phone apps connect to the proxy as if it were a single Jellyfin server and see the libraries of all configured servers combined (same-named libraries merged, optional de-duplication of movies and shows). Playback, HLS transcoding and watch state go to the server that owns each item. Users and upstream servers are configured in /config/config.toml; on first start, if that file is missing, the container writes /config/config.example.toml and stops with instructions. Plain HTTP by default; TLS (inbound or to the upstream servers) is optional.
Container.Requires: Create /config/config.toml (see the example written on first start). The appdata folder must be writable by uid 99 (nobody).

Config.Name: Jellyfin port
Config.Description: Port clients connect to ([proxy] listen in config.toml, default 0.0.0.0:8096). HTTP unless [tls] is configured.

Config.Name: Metrics port (optional)
Config.Description: Only if [metrics] listen = "0.0.0.0:9090" is set; by default /metrics is served on the Jellyfin port. Leave empty to not map it.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: config.toml and the proxy's data (/config/data: id map, sessions). Must be writable by uid 99.

Config.Name: Certificates (optional)
Config.Description: OPTIONAL. Only if config.toml enables [tls] or a [server.tls] ca_path / client certificate. Leave empty for plain HTTP; the container starts fine without it.

Config.Name: JMP_CONFIG
Config.Description: Path of the config file inside the container.

Config.Name: RUST_LOG
Config.Description: Optional log filter overriding [logging] filter, e.g. info,jmp=debug. Secrets are never logged.
